days.title: Land and go slow
days.summary: A light first day. Pick up the car, get to the hotel, walk by the water and sleep early.

items.title: Land in Auckland and collect the rental car
items.what: Clear passport control, fetch bags and pick up the car at the airport rental desks.

items.title: Check in at the hotel
items.what: Drop the bags, shower, and stay awake until at least 8 pm to reset your body clock.

items.title: Harbour walk at Viaduct Harbour
items.what: A flat, 20 minute stroll along the waterfront past moored yachts, with dinner at one of the restaurants on the quay.
items.story: The marina was rebuilt for the America's Cup, and the superyachts parked here are often worth more than the whole street.

drive.title: Airport to the hotel
drive.intro: A short motorway drive, on the left side of the road. Take it slowly while the jet lag wears off.

stops.note: Hotel parking is beneath the building.

days.title: The scenic way to Rotorua
days.summary: Two easy stops on the way south, each close to the car park.

items.title: Leave Auckland
items.what: Head south on State Highway 1 toward Hamilton.

items.title: Hamilton Gardens
items.what: A collection of themed gardens (Japanese, Italian, English and more), each one a small walled room you wander through on flat paths.
items.story: Each garden recreates a different era or culture, so you can cross continents and centuries before lunch.

items.title: Skyline Rotorua gondola
items.what: A gondola ride up Mount Ngongotaha for a view over Lake Rotorua, with an optional downhill luge ride on wheeled carts.
items.story: The luge tracks are a Rotorua invention that has since been copied around the world.

items.title: Check in at the Rotorua hotel
items.what: Settle in. You may notice a faint egg smell from the geothermal steam in town.

drive.title: Auckland to Rotorua via the gardens and the gondola
drive.intro: About three hours of driving spread over a full day.

stops.note: Look for the car park beside the entrance on Hungerford Crescent.
Park in the lot at the gondola base.

episode.title: The Road to Rotorua
episode.about: A short episode for the drive south. Start it as you leave Auckland.

days.title: Geysers and Maori culture
days.summary: Wai-O-Tapu in the morning for the geyser show, Te Puia in the afternoon.

items.title: Drive to Wai-O-Tapu
items.what: A 30 minute drive south through farmland and forest.

items.title: Lady Knox Geyser
items.what: Rangers drop a little soap into a geyser vent, and a few minutes later a column of water shoots up to ten metres.
items.story: The eruption was discovered in 1901 when prisoners washing their clothes in the hot water dropped in soap.

items.title: Walk the thermal park
items.what: A one hour boardwalk loop past steaming craters, a bright orange hot lake (the Champagne Pool) and a bright green pond.

items.title: Te Puia
items.what: A guided walk through a geothermal valley, a carving school and a kiwi house, with the Pohutu Geyser erupting several times a day.
items.story: Pohutu means big splash. It erupts about 20 times a day, up to 30 metres high.

items.title: Dinner in town
items.what: Eat on Eat Street (Tutanekai Street), a short walk from the hotel.

drive.title: Rotorua to Wai-O-Tapu and Te Puia
drive.intro: Two short drives, one in each direction.

days.title: Hobbiton and back to Auckland
days.summary: A guided walk through the film set in the early afternoon, then the drive back to the city.

items.title: Check out and drive to Hobbiton
items.what: About an hour on the road to Matamata. Arrive 15 minutes before the tour.

items.title: Hobbiton tour
items.what: A 2 hour guided walk through the hobbit holes and gardens, finishing with a drink at the Green Dragon Inn.
items.story: The set was built for the films in 1998 on a working sheep farm, then rebuilt permanently for the Hobbit films.

items.title: Arrive in Auckland
items.what: Check in and have a quiet dinner. Pack tonight for tomorrow's flight.

drive.title: Rotorua to Hobbiton and back to Auckland
drive.intro: Sheep farms, then the motorway. Fill the tank before returning the car.

stops.note: Park at the Shire's Rest and take the shuttle bus to the set.

days.title: One last view, then home
days.summary: A relaxed morning, then the airport.

items.title: Sky Tower
items.what: An elevator ride up 220 metres to a glass-floor viewing deck with views across the whole city and both harbours.

items.title: Return the rental car
items.what: Refuel first, then drop the car at the airport rental return and take the walkway to the terminal.

drive.title: Hotel to the airport
drive.intro: Leave extra time for the Saturday traffic on the motorway.

bookings.title: Rental car, 5 days
bookings.notes: Automatic, two drivers named. Bring the driver's licence and the international driving permit.

bookings.title: Auckland hotel, 12-13 Jan and 15-16 Jan
bookings.notes: Hold the bags on 16 Jan if the room has to be vacated early.

bookings.title: Wai-O-Tapu entry, 3 tickets
bookings.notes: Show the QR code from the confirmation email.

bookings.title: Hobbiton Movie Set tour, 3 tickets
bookings.notes: Timed ticket: arrive early, the shuttle leaves on schedule.

checklist.title: Passports valid for 3 months past the trip
checklist.notes: Check every traveller, including the teenager.

checklist.title: NZeTA and the tourist levy
checklist.notes: Needed for every visa-waiver traveller. One application per person, paid together with the visitor levy.

checklist.title: NZ Traveller Declaration
checklist.notes: Submit online for the whole group. Save the confirmation.

checklist.title: International driving permit
checklist.notes: Needed when the licence is not in English. Ask the rental desk which they require; carry both licence and permit.

checklist.title: Travel insurance
checklist.notes: Check cover for the rental car excess, medical care and the activities planned.

checklist.title: Confirm rental pickup and return times
checklist.notes: Pickup 14:30 on 12 Jan, return 11:30 on 16 Jan. Check the late-arrival rules if the flight is delayed.

checklist.title: Timed tickets saved offline
checklist.notes: Wai-O-Tapu (10:15 geyser) and Hobbiton (13:00 tour). Screenshot the QR codes.

checklist.title: Phone data sorted
checklist.notes: eSIM or roaming plan. This app works offline once it has loaded once.
